model.sectionDesc: The LLM used for clip analysis. API keys are stored locally and never uploaded.
model.serviceUrlHint: Default {{baseUrl}}, only needed if port is customized. Download from {{app}} official website if not installed.

model.urlFormatError: Please enter a URL starting with http:// or https://

model.localSelectHint: Select from loaded models in the local service.

model.connectionTestHintCloud: Test API key and model availability before saving.

speech.sectionDesc: When video has no subtitles, use local Whisper to generate subtitles before analysis. Not needed for videos with subtitles (e.g. Bilibili). Installing runtime and models is optional.
speech.notSupported: Local transcription is not supported on this platform.
speech.onDemandHint: On-demand install, ~200–400 MB (excluding PyTorch). Select and download a model after installation.
speech.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall Whisper runtime? Downloaded models will not be deleted.
speech.modelsHint: Models are stored locally. base or small recommended; medium / large-v3 for higher accuracy with good GPU.
speech.deleteModelConfirm: Delete model {{name}}? Can be re-downloaded later.

app.autostartHint: Launch automatically on system boot, access from system tray. Desktop only.
app.analyticsHint: Only collects anonymous feature usage and processing outcomes. Never collects video content, subtitle text, or API keys. If disabled, feedback will open an external form.
app.languageHint: Switch UI display language, applies immediately.
app.bilibiliAccountHint: Multi-account management and one-click publishing, coming soon.

feedback.sectionDesc: Tell us what is broken or what you need. Runtime environment is attached automatically without video content or API keys.
feedback.sendFeedbackHint: Write a sentence in-app; reviewed weekly.
feedback.feedbackFormHint: Use if you prefer external forms or wish to attach screenshots and logs.
feedback.githubHint: Developers can open an Issue directly (with template) or join Discussions.
feedback.knownIssuesHint: Release schedule, known bugs, and workarounds are in this pinned Issue.
